lines.zh: 我一步一步踩你的脚印
lines.en: I set my feet in your prints

lines.zh: 我踩着你刚才的脚印，没偏。
lines.en: I step in your fresh footprints, not missing one.
I do not walk fast, but I never stop

lines.zh: 我在你身后换了个位置
lines.en: I changed position behind you

lines.zh: 我的影子和你的一样长
lines.en: My shadow is as long as yours

lines.zh: 我经过的地方风会停一下
lines.en: The wind pauses where I pass
I walk slowly down the corridor
I never run after you

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你重叠在一起
lines.en: My steps fall exactly with yours
I will walk with you to the other side

lines.zh: 我走得比你的影子还慢
lines.en: I walk slower than your shadow

lines.zh: 我数着你的步子跟上去
lines.en: I count your steps and keep pace
I stand not far from your bed

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，只是站着
lines.en: I do nothing, I only stand

lines.zh: 我很安静，比呼吸还安静
lines.en: I am quiet, quieter than breathing
My hands hang at my sides

lines.zh: 我的脸在阴影里看不清
lines.en: My face is unclear in the shadow
I wait for you to find me yourself
I stay still, like furniture
I am in the corner of your room
I lift my head out of the shadow

lines.zh: 我把手放在门把上，不转
lines.en: I rest my hand on the knob and do not turn it
I sit down behind you

lines.zh: 你的椅子另一侧有我的重量
lines.en: There is my weight on the other side of your chair
I wait for you to count to ten

lines.zh: 我只有一点生命，可我一直笑。
lines.en: One point of life, and I keep smiling.
I have been waiting for you to turn
Have you seen me clearly

lines.zh: 我们不是认识很久了吗
lines.en: Have we not known each other a long time
Do not back away, we still have to talk
I smiled, you did not

lines.zh: 我只有一滴血，也够吓你。
lines.en: One point of health, and still I frighten you.
You ask why I am here

lines.zh: 我一直在，只是你没看到
lines.en: I was always here, you just did not see
Did you hear me speak
No need for formality between us
I raise a hand as if to shake
You do not remember me, I remember you
I will not leave unless you tell me to

lines.zh: 你回想一下，我们见过吗
lines.en: Think back, have we met
You actually know my face
Do not turn off the light, please
I watch over you while you sleep
I should not be able to feel pain
But I have lost a little of myself
It should not be like this between us
Look, I have turned transparent
This little bit hurts
I do not blame you for it
My shape is changing

lines.zh: 我们还能继续做朋友吗
lines.en: Can we still be friends
Do not look at my wound
I cannot stand quite steadily
What are you holding that for

lines.zh: 你把面包递来，我的手没抬。
lines.en: You offer bread; my hand doesn't rise.
You hold it out, I do not take it
We do not need such things between us
What are you proving with it
Just leave it on the table

lines.zh: 我看着你的手，不看着它
lines.en: I watch your hand, not it
Your fingers twitched once
I do not want this
Keep holding it

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我几乎没有重量
lines.en: You bumped me, I weigh almost nothing

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，我晃了一下
lines.en: We brushed past, I wavered
I step back, you are still there
I have noted that touch
It does not hurt, do not worry
The part you touched is cold
We are a little closer now
I press back to the wall again
We are not that kind of thing
I am only your friend
That is not yours to ask

lines.zh: 你说我是你的朋友，那就别走。
lines.en: You called me your friend; then do not leave.
I need nothing else
I laugh very softly, very thin
Your question is strange
I have always been here with you
Is this not nice enough
I shift and still watch you

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起你掉的东西
lines.en: I bend down and pick up what you dropped
I hold it out to you

lines.zh: 你手伸过来的时候我又收回了
lines.en: I pull it back when you reach
We share things, do we not
I will keep this one
It weighs nothing in my palm
I will not lose it
Look, I gave it back
We need not keep accounts
Are you leaving now

lines.zh: 你转身的动作我都看见了
lines.en: I saw you turn
I will not stand in your way
But I will still follow you
Whichever way you go, I go
I have always been your friend
Look back at me once
I have been standing right here
You need not walk so fast
We still have a lot to say
You got up, so did I
You should not go into that room
I match your pace
I could touch you if I reached

lines.zh: 你的影子在动，我的也是
lines.en: Your shadow moves, and so does mine
We are headed the same way
I follow you down the corridor
You paused at the door
I paused too
I stay two blocks behind you
Do not think of running
I know this place better than you
You went the wrong way
I have never left
We walk to the end together
I am half a step behind and to your side
You count doors, I count you
The corridor is long, we are in no hurry

lines.zh: 你的名字我又默念了一遍
lines.en: I said your name over again
The faster you walk, the closer I am
I have not blinked once
I am with you the whole way

lines.zh: 门后和门前对我来说一样
lines.en: Behind the door and before it are the same to me
I am one last step from you

lines.zh: 你刚才的自语我听见了
lines.en: I heard what you muttered
I reach out and touch your shoulder
I felt no pain from that
I only wanted you to stop
You walked on again
My hand is a little cold
Why do you shrink from me
Are we not friends
I did not put any force in it
Look, I left nothing behind
I pull my hand back
I take hold of your wrist
My fingers are very light
I only wanted you to wait for me
You pulled free, and I did not chase
This left nothing behind
Do not take me for a threat
I have been waiting in your room
We have known each other a long time
You are finally back

lines.zh: 你回头之前，我就站在墙角。
lines.en: I stood in the corner before you turned.
I take no room standing here
You need not entertain me
My place is right there
Look how alike we are
I will wait for you to wake
Do not shut that door
I have come, and I am not leaving

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后的那个位置
lines.en: I have always been in that spot behind you

lines.zh: 你的房间里多了一个人
lines.en: There is one more person in your room

lines.zh: 你转身的时候我就在了
lines.en: I was there when you turned
I called your name, you did not answer

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离从来没变过
lines.en: The distance between us has never changed
I wait for you to put out the light
This room has two breaths in it
Do not be afraid, it is me
I have sat down, right beside you
The fire shows me very clearly

lines.zh: 我掉下去的时候没有声音
lines.en: I made no sound as I fell

lines.zh: 我不会淹死，但水让我不舒服
lines.en: I will not drown, but the water unsettles me

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹散了又聚回来
lines.en: The blast scattered me, then I gathered again

lines.zh: 那个洞一直留在我身上
lines.en: That hole stays in me

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的轮廓发亮
lines.en: That magic made my outline glow

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，所以这不是饿
lines.en: I do not eat, so this is not hunger

lines.zh: 雷光里我第一次看清自己
lines.en: In the lightning I saw myself clearly
The emptiness here out-empties me
